∀ {n : ℕ} (b A : Fin n → ℝ),
  Ne.{1} A 0 →
    Eq.{1} (AuditRound9.euclidean_project b A)
      (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} b
        (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (dotProduct.{0, 0} b A) (dotProduct.{0, 0} A A)) A))

name: AuditRound9.projection_idempotent
type_compact:
∀ {n : ℕ} (b A : Fin n → ℝ),
  Eq.{1} (AuditRound9.euclidean_project (AuditRound9.euclidean_project b A) A) (AuditRound9.euclidean_project b A)

name: AuditRound9.projection_tangent
type_compact: ∀ {n : ℕ} (b A : Fin n → ℝ), Eq.{1} (dotProduct.{0, 0} (AuditRound9.euclidean_project b A) A) 0

name: AuditRound9.projection_zero
type_compact: ∀ {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℝ), Eq.{1} (AuditRound9.euclidean_project b 0) b

name: AuditRound9.scale_inverse
type_compact: ∀ (ω : ℝ), Ne.{1} ω 0 → Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (AuditRound9.state_unscale ω) (AuditRound9.state_scale ω)) 1
